name: stackrabbit
description: A fast performance trace viewer: open ETW traces (.etl) and explore CPU usage, waits and stacks, with every click answered at once.

stackrabbit.path.description: The stackrabbit engine to run. Empty: the one that comes with the extension.

stackrabbit.downloadSymbols.description: Download the PDBs a trace's stacks need from the symbol servers, in the background, when it opens.

stackrabbit.symbolCache.description: Where downloaded PDBs go, laid out as WinDbg's cache is (so the two can share it). Empty: _NT_SYMBOL_PATH's cache, else WinDbg's default (C:\ProgramData\Dbg\sym).

stackrabbit.stackTags.description: A file of stack tags, in WPA's format, for grouping stacks by what they are doing (Group by: Stack tag).

stackrabbit.lineHeat.description: Show time by source line in source files' editors: each line's share of the open trace's CPU samples (here or in what it calls), its own share, and a background by how hot it is. Files are matched to the paths the trace's symbols name by their names and as much of their paths as agree.

stackrabbit.symbolServers.description: Symbol servers, asked in order. Empty: _NT_SYMBOL_PATH's, else Microsoft's (https://msdl.microsoft.com/download/symbols).
